title: Tessera UTM zone 30 geospatial embeddings
description:
Tessera (geoemb convention) 128-band geospatial embeddings for UTM zone 30N, Zarr V3, single level, EPSG:32630, 10 m GSD. `embeddings` is [time(9), band(128), y(1011712), x(69632)], int8, sharded: the shard ("chunk_grid" chunk_shape) is [1, 128, 4096, 4096] -- 128 x 4096 x 4096 x 1 byte = 2,147,483,648 bytes (2 GiB) per shard, uncompressed -- considerably larger than this fixture's brief estimated ("shard 390MB"); the real on-disk shard is about 5x that estimate. The inner chunk within each shard is [1, 128, 32, 32] (blosc-zstd-bitshuffle).

License for this GeoTessera-derived product is not published on the source.coop listing; declared "proprietary".

Expected browser outcome: guards must prevent any large fetch -- whether via the amplification guard (the shard holds all 128 bands and a 4096x4096 spatial footprint for one request) or a dedicated shard-size guard, no client should ever pull a 2 GiB shard to render one tile.

embeddings.description: Shard (outer chunk) is [1,128,4096,4096] = 2 GiB uncompressed per shard, far larger than a single map tile needs.

data.title: Tessera UTM30 embeddings (Zarr V3, sharded, EPSG:32630)
